MOVE-A04.scope: Ten standard four-round ongoing moves: 2 typeless dice at round end, defenses ignored, first ongoing source only. Blocking is separate; Clamp blocks both participants. Source-defined evasion difficulty remains GM discretion. Cleanse removes the matching ongoing trap, not independent scene blocks.
